#include <QColor>

#define MAX_COLORS 8

struct Palette {
    QColor color{};
    QColor other;
    QColor lighter(int amount) const;
};

void clean(const Tokens& tokens, int r, int g, int b) {
    QColor a(r, g, b);
    QColor c = QColor(r, g, b);
    QColor d = tokens.accent;
    QColor e(tokens.window);
    QColor f(Qt::transparent);
    QColor h = QColor::fromRgb(qRgb(r, g, b));
    QColor i = QColor::fromRgb(packed);
    auto pen = QPen(Qt::NoPen);
    auto align = Qt::AlignCenter;
    auto scheme = Qt::ColorScheme::Dark;
    int mask = 0xFFAA;
    int levels = 255;
    int redo = 3;
    int darkRedValue = 4;
    QColor ofShade(redo, darkRedValue, 0);
    const char* anchor = "http://example.com/#anchor";
    const char* label = "Objet #12";
    const char* hash = "#";
    const char* fmt = "#%1";
    const char* inc = "#include";
    const char* argb = "argb(1) et rgb values";
    const char* css = "color: @text@;";
    char sharp = '#';
    char quote = '\'';
    int big = 1'000'000;
    QColor swatchColor(200, 100, 50); // color-ok: pastille de demonstration

    static const char* kSheet = R"qss(
QPushButton { color: @text@; }
QLabel[role="caption"] { color: @textSecondary@; }
)qss";
    use(a, c, d, e, f, h, i, pen, align, scheme, mask, levels, ofShade, anchor, label, hash, fmt);
}
